name: Creamy Orzo Pasta Casserole with Salmon, Herbed Cheese, Spinach & Zucchini

instructions.primary_message: Preheat oven to 425°F. Coat a large baking dish with a thin layer of oil.

Wash, dry, and trim zucchini. Halve lengthwise, then slice crosswise into ¼-inch thick half-moons. Place in the baking dish, along with broth, orzo, and spices, then stir to combine. Add Boursin cheese, nestling it into the center of the dish (do not stir).
instructions.secondary_message:
3 medium zucchini squash
3 cups chicken or vegetable broth
283 g orzo pasta
¾ tsp oregano, dried
½ tsp garlic powder
½ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper
1 (147 g) pkg Boursin Gournay cheese, garlic-herb flavor

instructions.primary_message: Cover baking dish tightly with aluminum foil and place casserole in the preheated oven. Bake until the orzo is starting to soften, 30 minutes.
While the casserole is cooking, wash and dry the spinach (skip this step if it came pre-washed). Roughly chop.

When the orzo has started to soften, remove baking dish from the oven. Add spinach to the dish, then stir to combine with the cheese and orzo. Re-cover with foil, return to the oven, and continue to bake until the orzo is tender, 10 minutes more. Remove from oven and allow to stand, 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, coat a baking sheet pan with a thin layer of oil.

Pat the salmon dry with paper towels and transfer to the baking sheet. Drizzle with additional oil, then season the top-side with salt and pepper. Add to the oven and roast until salmon is cooked through, 8-10 minutes. Remove from oven.
instructions.secondary_message:
680 g salmon fillet
1 tsp extra virgin olive oil
½ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: When the salmon is done, flake with a fork (discarding skin). Add flaked salmon to the orzo casserole and gently stir to combine.
To serve, divide casserole between plates and enjoy!
